posts.title: The Mathematical AI Safety Institute wants to prove AI is safe the way cryptographers prove codes are unbreakable
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman launches MAISI (Bay Area, Jan 2027) to pursue cryptographic-style proofs of AI safety; he is also joining OpenAI's safety team.

posts.title: Anthropic's $1.5 billion book settlement descends into chaos as authors and publishers fight over who gets paid
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Authors and publishers file competing claims over Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement ($3k/book across ~482k titles); arbitrator to resolve disputes.

posts.title: Due to GPT-6 Astra demand, OpenAI has paused new subscriptions to its $200 ChatGPT Pro tier
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): OpenAI pauses new ChatGPT Pro signups after Astra demand strains capacity; working to add capacity.

posts.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): OpenAI pauses new ChatGPT Pro signups after GPT-6 Astra demand strains systems.

posts.title: Introducing the Agents API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): Public-beta Agents API exposes the managed Codex/ChatGPT agent harness — context management, parallel tools, sub-agents; token billing only.

posts.title: OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Agents API beta lets apps run long-lived cloud agents with MCP/custom tools and partner sandboxes (Cloudflare, Vercel, Oracle).

posts.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): GPT-Live-1 full-duplex voice API at $0.05/min; can delegate reasoning/tools to Astra or other backends.

posts.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Anthropic threat report alleges industrial-scale Claude distillation and multi-agent misuse by Chinese labs and state-linked actors.

posts.title: Anthropic disrupts Russian, Chinese AI campaigns targeting its Claude models
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 10): Anthropic says it disrupted Russia-linked espionage and China-lab efforts to extract/replicate Claude via multi-agent frameworks.

posts.title: Anthropic says AI now lets lone operators run state-level hacking campaigns
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): Anthropic report: lone operators run state-scale intrusions with agent swarms; names Alibaba/Moonshot/DeepSeek distillation plus Midnight Blizzard-style ops.

posts.title: Six Chinese AI firms accused of aggressively copying US frontier models
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 9): Coverage of Anthropic's accusations that Chinese labs aggressively distill US frontier models; US urge to ID/switch Chinese users.

posts.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash, says it outperforms flagship V4-Pro
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): DeepSeek ships V4.1-Flash (552B MoE, MIT weights); claims it beats V4-Pro on agent/coding benches with much smaller KV cache; V4-Pro traffic routes to Flash Sep 14.

posts.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Meta's Muse personal AI agent climbs to No. 2 on US app charts shortly after launch.

posts.title: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 10): Hands-on with Meta Muse — capable personal agent that shops/books forms, with privacy/creepiness tradeoffs.

posts.title: Chipmaker Positron nabs $875M to speed up inference with consumer-grade memory
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): Positron raises $875M to accelerate AI inference using consumer-grade memory.

posts.title: Ayar Labs bags $150M in additional late-stage funding to help make bigger AI chip clusters
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): Optical I/O startup Ayar Labs adds $150M late-stage funding for larger AI chip clusters.

posts.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang outlines why he expects ~70% growth next year, driven by AI infrastructure demand.

posts.title: Panic builds over bankrupt Spirit’s looming data sale to Google
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 10): Advocates warn Spirit Airlines bankruptcy data sale to Google could become an AI training data land grab.

posts.title: AI Models Are Watermarking Text—Will You Notice?
posts.summary: IEEE Spectrum (Sep 9): Anthropic/Google-style invisible text watermarks for AI outputs — how they work and whether users will notice.

posts.title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
posts.summary: Hugging Face Blog (Sep 9): IBM Research ships Granite time-series PatchTST-FM-r2 as SOTA with a commercial-friendly license.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals estimated at $517B+
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @validapau estimates Anthropic's total compute bill/deals around $517B+ — not independently verified; treat as rumor only.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @amir reports Nvidia in talks to invest ~$2.5–3B in Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab (via a16z) — unverified; rumor only.

rumors.title: SoftBank talks to buy majority of OpenAI-backed 1X at ~$6B
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @validapau reports SoftBank talks for majority stake in OpenAI-backed 1X around ~$6B — unverified; rumor only.
